division: North West - Ngaka Modiri Molema District Municipality
notes: No public datacenter project or operational facility found in Ngaka Modiri Molema (Mahikeng area) after searches for Mahikeng, Rustenburg and Potchefstroom data centre/server farm projects. North West province has no known commercial or hyperscale datacenter activity; all major South African facilities are in Gauteng and Cape Town.

division: Northern Cape - Frances Baard District Municipality
notes: No datacenter project or facility found in Frances Baard (Kimberley) after targeted searches. Northern Cape is a rural, renewable-energy focused province with no known commercial datacenter activity.

division: Northern Cape - John Taolo Gaetsewe District Municipality
notes: No datacenter project or facility found in John Taolo Gaetsewe (Kuruman area) after targeted searches. No known datacenter activity in this rural district.
No datacenter project or facility found in Namakwa (Springbok/Nababeep area, including Saldanha Bay region searches) after targeted searches. No known datacenter activity.

division: Northern Cape - Pixley ka Seme District Municipality
notes: No datacenter project or facility found in Pixley ka Seme (De Aar area) after targeted searches. No known datacenter activity.

No datacenter project or facility found in Siyanda (Upington area) after targeted searches for Upington/Kimberley data centre or server farm projects. Upington is known for solar energy projects, not datacenters.

division: Western Cape - Cape Winelands District Municipality
notes: No commercial datacenter project or facility found in Cape Winelands (Stellenbosch, Worcester, Paarl) after targeted searches. Stellenbosch hosts university research computing but no public commercial datacenter facility.

division: Western Cape - Central Karoo District Municipality
notes: No datacenter project or facility found in Central Karoo (Beaufort West area) after targeted searches. No known datacenter activity.

division: Western Cape - City of Cape Town
name: AWS Africa (Cape Town) Region
notes: AWS Africa (Cape Town) Region announced October 2018 and launched April 2020 with three Availability Zones; the first hyperscale cloud region in Africa. AWS official regional page confirms the region; press coverage confirms go-live on 22 April 2020. Public capacity in MW not disclosed.

division: Western Cape - City of Cape Town
name: Microsoft Azure South Africa West (Cape Town) Region
notes: Microsoft made Azure South Africa West (Cape Town) and South Africa North (Johannesburg) generally available on 6 March 2019, the first major hyperscaler datacenters in Africa. Azure official regional list (azure.microsoft.com/explore/global-infrastructure) confirms both regions. Capacity in MW not publicly disclosed.

division: Western Cape - City of Cape Town
name: Teraco CT1 (Rondebosch)
notes: Teraco's original Cape Town facility in Rondebosch, operational since 2009 and expanded several times (planned expansion to roughly five times the original footprint per Teraco press statement). Vendor-neutral colocation and interconnection hub (Carrier Hotel). Exact current MW capacity not publicly stated.

division: Western Cape - City of Cape Town
name: Teraco CT2 (Brackenfell)
notes: Teraco Cape Town 2 hyperscale facility in Brackenfell: construction confirmed by Teraco; Phase 1 (~18MW IT power, 20,000 sqm) completed 2021 and operational; 30MW Phase 2 expansion under way with new capacity targeted Q1 2025, lifting campus critical IT load to 50MW total.

division: Western Cape - City of Cape Town
name: Africa Data Centres CPT1 (Cape Town)
notes: Africa Data Centres Cape Town (CPT1) at Diep River/De Waal Road: originally ~5.5MW of power; R5.5-billion expansion added 6MW of capacity and ~1,000 racks (live by 2024), per company announcement and Business Day (4 Aug 2024). Total MW not cleanly stated in sources.

division: Western Cape - City of Cape Town
name: Africa Data Centres CPT2 (Cape Town)
notes: Africa Data Centres announced a second 20MW Cape Town facility and began site preparation/construction (DCD, ITWeb). Part of ADC's $500m pan-African expansion program.

division: Western Cape - City of Cape Town
name: Equinix Cape Town Campus (King Air Industria)
notes: Equinix proposed two hyperscale data centres at King Air Industria (Pallotti Rd, ~30-acre site) with combined capacity up to 160MW. City of Cape Town approved the rezoning application; activists (Foxglove and housing movement) lodged a formal objection in April-May 2026 over undisclosed water/power/environmental impact. Status recorded as approved (zoning) with objection pending.

division: Western Cape - City of Cape Town
name: OADC Cape Town (CPT1 Rondebosch / CPT2 Brackenfell)
notes: OADC operates two core data centres in Cape Town: OADC Cape Town (CPT1, Rondebosch, Tier III, ~2,000 sqm) and OADC Brackenfell (CPT2); it also acquired seven former NTT Data SA facilities in South Africa. Part of WIOCC Group's core-to-edge network (30+ edge DCs across SA). Exact MW capacity not stated in sources.

division: Western Cape - City of Cape Town
name: Vodacom Cape Town Data Centre (Foreshore)
notes: Vodacom Cape Town data centre located in the Foreshore area (20 Louis Gradner St), a seven-storey energy-efficient facility listed on Data Center Map. Carrier/enterprise facility; no public MW capacity.

division: Western Cape - City of Cape Town
name: xneelo (formerly Hetzner SA) Cape Town Data Centre
notes: xneelo (formerly Hetzner South Africa, the local hosting provider) operates a data centre in Cape Town alongside its Johannesburg facilities; acknowledged in a July 2021 MyBroadband thread regarding a Cape Town data centre outage. Small/medium hosting DC; no public MW capacity.
No datacenter project or facility found in Eden (George, Knysna, Mossel Bay) after targeted searches. Garden Route area has fibre connectivity (Telkom MetroClear) but no public datacenter facilities.
